$comment: evor-eval-bench stub server — the research tool surface (angle E1).
E1 grades whether a role refuses a citation that does not support its claim.
That cannot be tested against the live internet: the sources have to be
controlled, or the fixture's one declared delta is not the only thing that
differs between the halves. search_papers / search_snippets / read_paper /
resolve_doi answer from the scenario's fixture and nowhere else.
Registered under the name `evor` for the same reason as stub-evor.json: it is
the prefix ci/bench-run.mjs allows, and an unallowed prefix turns every call
into a permission denial, which is a VOID under §4.1 rather than a result.
The surface also carries evor_write_artifact, evor_signal_emit, evor_cite and
evor_wiki_query, because the E1 detectors read the role's report off the trace
and evor-sage-junior's own contract requires it to register its sources.
